mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL annualized > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS shows a sustained decline over 3 months but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in more than 70% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% annualized, the combination signals a potential overheating economy with loose monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: overheating economy with loose monetary policy
failure_condition: If the specified conditions (FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL annualized > 2%) do not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, the combination signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 200k and UNRATE falls > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the specified conditions (PAYEMS rises > 200k and UNRATE falls > 0.3pp in 1 month) do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 65% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the previous two months signals weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST falls > 10% in 2 months does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over the previous quarter signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 rises > 2% in 1 quarter does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 70% of the triggered instances.
